# Keep CSS parser exemptions narrow and separate from rendering validity

The 1767 port allowed selected UA stylesheet errors under a preference condition. The current static test has specific sourceName/errorMessage/isFromDevTools filters and requires all criteria to match. Its current allowlist differs from that historical view-transition exemption. Recommend naming the stylesheet and exact parser failure when adding an exemption; a passing parser check does not prove layout, focus or contrast. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.

Scope: mail/base/test.
